name: create_game
description: Creates a new D&D game session. All other functions require a game slug, so this must be called first.

slug.description: A unique, URL-safe identifier for the game (e.g., 'lost-mines-2024'). Used to reference this game in all other function calls.

name.description: The display name of the game (e.g., 'Lost Mines of Phandelver').

description.description: Optional notes or description for the game.
